description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named EmployeeSearchController. It handles HTTP requests related to searching, printing, and exporting client data for employees. The class includes methods for default search, city-based search, status-based search, name-based search, and functionalities to print or export the search results. It interacts with various services and repositories such as ClientRepository, ClientService, PdfService, and CsvImportExportService.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing employee search operations, including client search by various criteria, printing, and exporting client lists.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds common attributes to the model, such as the list of statuses.

methods.name: defaultSearch
methods.description: Performs default client search for the authenticated user.

methods.name: citySearch
methods.description: Searches clients based on the city of the authenticated user's office.

methods.name: statusSearch
methods.description: Searches clients by status within the user's city.

methods.name: nameSearch
methods.description: Searches clients by name within the user's city.

methods.name: printSearch
methods.description: Generates a PDF with the list of searched clients.

methods.name: exportSearch
methods.description: Exports the searched client list to a CSV file.
